title: BSD OQ-01: Finiteness of Ш(E/ℚ) via Kolyvagin's Euler System
description: Proves finiteness of the Tate-Shafarevich group Ш(E/ℚ)[p^∞] for elliptic curves E/ℚ with analytic rank ≤ 1, using Kolyvagin's Euler system. Rank 0: L(E,1)≠0 → Kolyvagin bounds p-Selmer rank 0 → Ш[p^∞] finite. Rank 1: Gross-Zagier (1986) gives non-torsion Heegner point → Kolyvagin bounds rank 1 → Ш[p^∞] finite. Imports BirchSwinnertonDyer (17 axioms) + 8 own = 25 total.
